name: Get client info
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the logged‑in user's basic account details such as name, email, activated applications and visible channel listings. If you only need a subset of this data (e.g., just activated applications), use a more specific endpoint instead.

organization_id.description: Identifier of the organization the account belongs to.

name.description: Full name of the account holder.

email.description: Email address associated with the account.

account_invalidated.description: Indicates whether the account has been invalidated.

excluded_conversion_user.description: Flag indicating if the user is excluded from conversion tracking.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number of the user, if provided.

activated_applications.description: List of Brevo applications activated for this account.

visible_channel_listing.description: Channels that are visible in the UI for this account.
